recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia-toned composition featuring an ornate Victorian-style oval frame containing a portrait, set against a background of diagonal sheet music, an inkwell, and a quill pen.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal orientation of the sheet music creates dynamic movement against the vertical frame.
The ornate texture of the frame contrasts with the clean, rhythmic lines of the musical staff.
The sepia color palette unifies disparate elements into a cohesive historical aesthetic.
coreInvariants: Ornate, filigreed oval frame as a primary focal point
Musical notation as a textural background element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: An ornate oval frame is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, occupying approximately one-third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, detailed frame acts as the primary anchor, grounding the lighter background elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large script in the top left, follows the diagonal lines of the music down to the frame, and then moves right toward the inkwell and quill.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right area provides breathing room for secondary text against the textured paper background.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark chocolate brown (text, frame shadows, musical notes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone tan (shading on the quill and frame highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark ink and the light parchment-like background.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with very thin upstrokes and thick downstrokes
Elongated, looping flourishes on capital letters
Connected cursive lowercase letters with a slight rightward slant
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on the initial 'S' and 'L' to fill negative space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in varying sizes to maintain a formal, classical look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, flourished calligraphic style of the original.
Provides the necessary elegance and stroke contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned background featuring a diagonal sheet of musical manuscript. In the lower left, place a highly ornate, Victorian-style oval frame. To the right of the frame, include a vintage inkwell and a white quill pen resting on the music paper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add text in a dark brown formal script font. Place the primary title in the top left and the secondary name in the top right, ensuring the flourishes do not obscure the main imagery.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the musical notation oriented diagonally?
Does the script font have high contrast and elegant flourishes?
Is the frame sufficiently ornate and Victorian in style?

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos in the corners
Exact musical composition on the staff
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the quill looks integrated into the scene with a soft shadow.
Check that the script text is legible against the musical staff.
Verify the frame has a metallic or carved wood texture consistent with the era.
Confirm the diagonal lines of the music lead the eye toward the center.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vintage Object] + [Diagonal Background Texture] + [Ornate Frame] + [Formal Script Typography] + [Monochromatic Sepia Filter].
